Notes

1) The above unaudited consolidated financial results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 3, 2026 and has been subjected to review by the Statutory Auditors of the Company. These unaudited consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles provided in Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) 34 on 'Interim Financial Reporting', prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, as applicable and guidelines issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 as amended.

2) The Company completed its Initial Public Offering (“IPO”) comprising 53,879,309 equity shares of face value Rs.2 each at an issue price of Rs.232 per equity share. The IPO included a fresh issue of 21,551,724 equity shares by the Company and an offer for sale of 32,327,585 equity shares by the selling shareholders. Pursuant to the IPO, the equity shares of the Company were listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited on October 1, 2025

(ii) The Company has obtained Shareholder’s approval vide postal ballot resolution dated April 28, 2026, ratifying utilisation of IPO proceeds under General Corporate Purposes towards repayment of unsecured loan to the promoter of Rs. 540 million.

The actual issue expenses was Rs. 226.93 million, resulting in an unutilised balance of Rs. 36.64 million which was then reallocated to General Corporate Purposes pursuant to circular resolution dated October 7, 2026.

4) The consolidated financial results of the group includes the financial results of the subsidiary companies and share of profit/(loss) from associate and joint venture as applicable for the quarters ended September 30 2026, June 30 2026, September 30 2025, six months ended September 30 2026, September 30 2025 & year ended March 31 2026.

5) a) Pursuant to the approval of the Board of Directors in their meeting held on October 8, 2025 and the Joint Venture Agreement signed on October 22, 2025 between the Company and C&Y Group Investments, Inc., “Jain CY Circular Solutions Private Limited”, a Joint Venture, was incorporated on December 08, 2025. During the previous year ended March 31, 2026, the Company has subscribed to 26,00,000 shares of Rs. 10 each, aggregating to Rs. 26.00 million. C&Y Group Investments, Inc. have also contributed to its share of the equity share capital of the Joint Venture.

b) During the six months ended September 30, 2026, the Company granted a loan of Rs. 197.37 Million to Jain CY Circular Solutions Private Limited, on the terms approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on February 09, 2026. The loan carries interest linked to the yield on the benchmark 10-year Government of India Security (G-Sec) and is repayable on demand. During the period ended September 30, 2026, the Company provided a corporate guarantee aggregating Rs. 1,000 Million in favour of ICICI Bank Limited on behalf of Jain CY Circular Solutions Private Limited. The guarantee was approved by the Borrowings & Investment Committee of the Board of Directors in two tranches of Rs. 500 Million each, at its meetings held on July 13, 2026 and September 17, 2026.

c) Pursuant to the revised agreement dated July 1, 2026, the Company has obtained control over Jain CY Circular Solutions Private Limited, which was hitherto classified as a Joint Venture. Accordingly, the said entity has been reclassified as a Subsidiary with effect from July 1, 2026, and its financial results are consolidated with those of the Company from the date on which control was obtained, in accordance with the applicable Indian Accounting Standards.

6) a) During the previous year ended March 31, 2026 Jain Ikon Global Ventures FZC has discontinued its operations on refining of precious metals.
b) Pursuant to the definitive agreement dated July 19, 2025, the Company has received the full repayment of the loan and interest from Sun Minerals Mannar Private Limited during the year ended March 31, 2026. The proposed sale of the Company’s 28.88% equity interest remains pending as on the date of these results.

7) The Company had executed a Loan Conversion Agreement on August 25, 2026 with its subsidiary, Jain Ikon Global Ventures FZC for converting the outstanding loan of Rs.445 Million (approx) as on August 24, 2026 into equity shares of Jain Ikon Global Ventures FZC at face value. The aforesaid loan conversion is pending approvals from the statutory authorities.

8) On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified four Labour Codes, effective immediately, replacing the existing 29 labour laws. In accordance with Ind AS 19 - Employee benefits, changes to benefit plans arising from legislative amendments are treated as plan amendments, requiring immediate recognition of past service cost in the Statement of Profit and Loss. This approach is consistent with the guidance issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. The Company has concluded the salary restructuring exercise in compliance with the Labour Codes. The implementation of the Labour Code has resulted in a net increase of Rs. 7.15 million in the provision for gratuity which has been recognised as employee benefit expense in the previous year.

10) On July 14, 2026, an accident involving a furnace explosion occurred at a section of the Company’s manufacturing facility at Gummidipoondi, resulting in damage to certain property, plant and equipment and inventories. The Company has assessed the extent of the damage and identified a loss of Rs. 18.56 million on property, plant and equipment and Rs.4.71 million on inventories, aggregating Rs.23.27 million. The Company has lodged a claim with its insurers, and the claim is under process. Pending its settlement, no amount has been recognised as recoverable from insurance in the financial results.

during the period.
